GFED_regional_dm_rho_scaled.csv - provenance (minimal hotfix: magpie4 2.83.0 mechanics, densities calibrated on data)
created: 2026-10-23 13:40 CEST
generator: github.com/mscrawford/Fire-Emissions, rho/minimal/build_baseline_table.R at bfae670: one script from the raw
           inputs (GFED4.1s, the reference run's clustermap and LanduseInitialisation, GFW loss by driver)
units: kg dry matter (DM) per m2 of the historical area of the class the fire type is applied to, per year
definition: rho(p, r) = mean annual GFED4.1s 2003-2016 DM mass of fire type p in H12 region r / historical area of
            the class magpie4 2.83.0 multiplies p by. Historical data, not a MAgPIE run (2.83.0's table was calibrated
            on one ScenarioMIP run's own areas, which made OAS DEFO_largeFires 52 kg DM/m2).
denominators:
  BORF, TEMF, DEFO_smallFires, PEAT: forest = primforest + secdforest + forestry (2.83.0 applies peat fire to forest)
  SAVA: past + range + primother + secdother; AGRI: crop
    (LanduseInitialisation, avl_land_full_t_0.5.mz of the reference run, 1995-2015 interpolated, period mean)
  DEFO_largeFires: GFW tree cover loss from ALL drivers (UMD/Hansen, 30% canopy; WRI/Google DeepMind driver map v1.13,
    Sims et al. 2025): land use, logging, wildfire, other natural disturbances, unknown; mean 2003-2016; countries to
    H12 with madrat's regionmappingH12.csv. All drivers because 2.83.0 applies it to forest reduction (conversion and
    harvest) plus disturbance loss. 0 below 0.01 Mha/yr; cap 20.3 kg DM/m2 (does not bind).
  Values: LAM 6.24, OAS 6.14, SSA 5.08, IND 5.17, CHA 0.57, CAZ 0.21, MEA 0.20 kg DM/m2.
checks (in the script): global GFED DM 4.217 Pg/yr (4.22 +- 2%); regional + unmapped mass equals the global mass per
  fire type; rho x area gives back the mass where no threshold or cap applies; global carbon per fire type equals
  GFED's published table (data/GFED4.1s_C.txt, 2003-2014) within max(1 Tg C, 0.5%) (largest gap 0.63 Tg C/yr).
cross-check: equals the earlier table built from the gated full pipeline (rho/run_rho.R, 24 checks) to 4.7e-14 relative.
